a.lede: A federal judge ruled that Apple can access OpenAI's interview materials involving former Apple employees, as well as private messages and testimony from key figures in the case.
a.title: Judge orders OpenAI to turn over hiring records in Apple trade secrets case

b.lede: ChatGPT maker turns tables in Apple's trade secrets lawsuit, claiming confidential hardware plans made their way back to Cupertino
b.title: OpenAI claims 100-plus secret files followed ex-employee back to Apple
